title: ProjectSettings: set_initial_value makes custom setting unavailabe runtime
body:
### Tested versions

Tested in:
- v4.5.beta1.official [46c495ca2]
- v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]
- v4.2.2.stable.official [15073afe3]

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7247) - AMD Ryzen 9 7945HX with Radeon Graphics (32 threads)

### Issue description

I'm creating a plugin and want to expose plugin options through project settings. I wanted to give each option an initial value using _set_initial_value_ method that is exposed in _ProjectSettings_. When I did that, I noticed that values set that way are unavailable during runtime. When using those settings through a tool script, in editor, everything works fine, but If I try to access them in autoload, when the game is running, _get_setting_ is always returning _null_.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a custom option through code and set its initial value through _set_initial_value_
2. Try to access those settings using _get_setting_ at runtime (for example in __ready_)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This project contains:
- Tool button for creating settings (first has initial value set, second does not)
- Tool button for printing values of created settings (should print values of both)
- __ready_ override, which prints values of created settings

[project_settings_bug_minimal.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20988545/project_settings_bug_minimal.zip)
